name: Self Condemnation
overview: Scripture reveals that self-condemnation arises when individuals recognize their sinfulness and confess their wrongdoing, as seen in Joshua's call for Achan to confess and David's plea to bear the consequences of his sin rather than his people. Job acknowledges the futility of self-justification, admitting that claiming perfection only brings further condemnation. The prayers in 1 Kings emphasize God's role in judging the wicked and justifying the righteous, underscoring the need for divine judgment rather than self-righteousness. Proverbs highlights the heart's resistance to correction, which can lead to personal condemnation when instruction is despised.
